correctness.rationale: Full proof: \(\mathbb F_q[C_{p^a}]\) is \(\mathbb F_q[X]/(X-1)^{p^a}\), giving a single shift-difference Jordan block. Semidirect powers are geometric sums \((T^i-I)^{p^b-1}\), whose valuation-dependent images and kernels yield every target root count, including exceptional identity fibers. Sum over p-adic top valuations gives image cardinality; unequal top fibers prove non-subgroup closure for \(b<a\). Exact quotient converges to lacunary series. 22 direct enumerated complete-fiber cases independently pass; not extrapolated as proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The symmetric-top wreath product G wreath S_n is a larger ambient group, but its generic power/class-count statements cannot be restricted by a simple substitution to count roots INSIDE the cyclic-top subgroup; the cyclic top has different exponent and multiplicities. The 2014 central-series work might contain adjacent structural lemmas but its complete text remains inaccessible and thus is not asserted not to cover every relevant ingredient.

value.rationale: The family is unbounded in \(p,a,q\) and the invariant is the natural \(p^b\) power-word map, not an arbitrary slice. All prescribed fibers refine order statistics, image cardinalities show nonuniform p-adic layers, the sharp subgroup threshold detects nontrivial closure failure, and the limit series describes stable quantitative behavior in large cyclic depth. These facts are not routine restatements of the classical Hall power identity.
